_doc: Performance ratchets for tests/performance.spec.js. Each fixture has a budget (ms) per phase. Specs assert metrics <= budget * tolerance. Update with `npm run test:perf -- --update-snapshots` after a justified change, then commit.
_toleranceNote: 2.0× absorbs parallel-test CPU contention. For tighter signal, run `npm run test:perf` in isolation (no visual-regression / smoke running concurrently).
_recordedOn: 2026-05-04 (initial generous baselines — ratchet downward after first CI run)

dwh-6.fixed.prerender.json._note: Pre-render fast-path target — should be substantially faster than dwh-6.fixed.json

dwh-stress.json._note: Synthetic 1,296-node stress fixture, generated via tests/generate-stress-fixture.js. Initial generous budgets — ratchet downward after Workstream C hot-path fixes land.

All.json._note: Real production export from a consumer dashboard (1017 nodes, 0 edges). Live perf-test target — when timings here regress it actually matters. Initial generous budgets; ratchet after observing one stable CI run.

All.prerender.json._note: Pre-render of All.json. Regenerate via `node scripts/generate-prerender.mjs dashboard/data/All.json` whenever the source changes.

directPages._doc: Pages that mount their own dataset (no fileSelect path). Same metrics shape as `fixtures`; loaded via direct navigation in tests/performance.spec.js.

/themes/02_theme-overview.html._note: Showcase page: 6 sections × 10 statuses + role children = 177 nodes (57 containers, 120 leaves, depth 3). After the Workstream C fix that swaps the redundant expand() call during init for a lean _postInitLayout pass (nodeBaseContainer.js:init), nodeInitialization dropped from ~7.7s to ~3.5s on the same hardware. Budget set 20% above current observation (4200ms) to absorb variance. Lower further once additional zone-init optimizations land.

fastPathRatio._doc: Ratio of pre-rendered total to cold total. fastPathRatio < 1 means pre-render is genuinely faster.

dwh-6.fixed._note: Pre-rendered SHOULD be faster than cold but on this fixture currently varies ~0.7-2.3× across consecutive runs. The dwh-6.fixed.prerender.json was generated before the fingerprint validator existed, so hasPrerenderData accepts it via the 'no-fingerprint' branch — but the warm-path tree walks (per-node prerender read + clearPrerenderData) cost more than they save vs. a 885-node cold layout that's already fast. Regenerating dwh-6.fixed.prerender.json with the current generator (scripts/generate-prerender.mjs) may close the gap. Threshold 2.5 catches a fast-path that has actively regressed without being noisy. See tests/perf-prerender-comparison.spec.js for per-phase visibility; the dwh-1 and dwh-5 pairs consistently show 0.6-0.7× as the prerender benefit they were designed to deliver.

All._note: Production-fixture warm/cold ratio. Same caveat as dwh-6.fixed — first-paint variance on fresh-page loads sometimes makes warm slower than cold. Threshold loosened until Workstream C edge/zone caches reduce variance.
